## 5. Equations

I found this beautiful equation in Dave's famous Reader [-@funda_reader]:

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x_0) + f′(x_0)(x − x_0) &= 0 \\
xf′(x_0) &= f′(x_0)x_0 − f(x_0) \\
x &= x_0 − \frac{f(x_0)}{f′(x_0)}
\end{aligned}
$$
